reviews.review: I liked it. So tired of open world games that demand you spend all of your time exploring mostly empty terrain. It was refreshing to play a game with a focused narrative and handcrafted level design. The set pieces were awesome, the combat was fun and violent. This game did the Warhammer series justice. I'm excited to play the sequel.

First off got this game through a third party for a mere fraction of the current steam price so I cannot complain about it being a full price 13 year old game. 

Secondly apart from a very long black screen load up its working perfectly - so also no complaints there but had been a little worried for a moment.

Game is what Ive always wanted from a warhammer game, how id imagine Ultra Marines battling it out. It is deliciously Violent, Stoic and unashamed in its delivery. Famous voice actors too. 3.2 hours in and im in awe. Currently on campaign and apart from not being able to save manually ive enjoyed every last minute of it. Weapons and variations are good and with the added fury system makes hack and slash/slow time gun play an absolute pleasure. 

I hope the online mode is still active and has a player base as id like to see what that entails and if its any good. Will update accordingly.

Solid purchase on sale, prob a bit pricey for a 13 year old game but if your a fan of Games Workshop and Warhammer/Space Marines its a must have.

Bring on the second game, cant wait.

I was very surprised by how good this game was. I got it for free some years ago when they gave it away, and only having played it now, I regret not doing it sooner. 

The gameplay is good and satisfying, and the story is interesting and easy to understand for someone that knows very little about 40k. The last sections of the game suffer from the "Throw ungodly hordes of enemies at the player because we don't know what else to do" syndrome, and it leads to some frustrating experiences (including the final fight) but it's not the worst.

Unfortunately (for me) this game has online achievements, so that's achievements I'm never going to get. The current price tag is a joke and was doubled after the sequel was announced. This is an almost 15 year old game, and should be bought on sale when the price matches the game's age.
